response.description:
Ever wondered how to allow auditing personas (i.e. security analyst in your organization or security assessment contractor) the ability to view your ledger files and establish trust in the cryptographic
 proofs themselves? With the new localized, web ledger explorer tool, ledger files can be imported to verify the authenticity of the ledger and the ledger data in its entirety. This tool enables a simple experience in viewing the merkle-tree proof visually
 to ensure all ledger contents are chained together.  Administrators of the ledger instances continue to have access to the ledger explorer feature in the portal experience, which provides similar view into the ledger contents.  Learn more.
response.title: General Availability: Backup your ledger files for audit with Azure confidential ledger’s new tool
